profile.name: Regina Septianadrah
profile.summaryEn: Highly skilled Structural Drafter with over nine years of experience in the architecture, engineering, and construction industry, specializing in Revit, AutoCAD, and advanced Point Cloud integration to deliver precise, compliant structural models and drawings. Adept at collaborating directly with BIM leadership, meeting tight deadlines, and adapting to evolving design requirements across both local and international projects.
profile.bioEn: I am a dedicated Structural Drafter with over nine years of experience in the architecture, engineering, and construction industry. I leverage Revit, AutoCAD, and point-cloud data to deliver precise, efficient, and code-compliant structural models and drawings. I work across commercial, industrial, and infrastructure projects while reporting directly to BIM leadership.
profile.aboutIntro: An Experienced Structural Drafter delivering high-precision structural design solutions
profile.resumeIntro: Results-oriented Structural Drafter skilled in translating complex engineering requirements into buildable Revit and AutoCAD designs, backed by advanced Point Cloud integration. Adept at maintaining compliance with industry standards, optimizing workflows, and supporting multidisciplinary teams on both local and international assignments.
profile.footerTagline: An Experienced Structural Drafter delivering high-precision structural design solutions

education.thesis: Redesign of a Ten-Story Hotel Utilizing Steel Structure in Compliance with SNI 1729:2020 and SNI 1726:2019

experiences.description:
Produced detailed structural BIM models, drawings, and reinforcement details using Revit for hospitality and data-center projects.
Translated architectural and engineering specifications into coordinated structural layouts, sections, and construction documentation.
Developed structural deliverables for Hotel Mandarin and BFB Fitness Hotel in Bali across design and construction stages.
Prepared early-phase foundation and load-bearing system documentation for data-center feasibility and engineering reviews.
Coordinated with structural engineers to incorporate design revisions and site updates into current models and drawings.
Maintained model and drawing accuracy, consistency, and alignment with project standards under demanding deadlines.

Produced Revit and AutoCAD structural models and drawings for commercial, data-center, educational, industrial, energy, and water-infrastructure projects.
Integrated point-cloud survey data into Revit models for structural assessments and accurate representation of existing conditions.
Delivered renovation and seismic-upgrade documentation for projects including Pondok Indah Mall, Puri Indah Mall, and Countdown Blenheim.
Modeled specialized structures including crane works, chemical-tank canopies, pipe racks, platforms, reactor foundations, and 500 kV installations.
Coordinated with structural engineers and multidisciplinary teams to incorporate technical feedback and support design reviews.
Managed multiple project deliverables and revisions while maintaining drafting accuracy, model consistency, and schedule requirements.

Produced detailed façade drawings for hotels, apartments, retail buildings, educational facilities, and public infrastructure projects.
Designed aluminum-framed doors and windows, aluminum composite panels, and curtain-wall systems based on architectural requirements.
Prepared dimensions, specifications, and construction details to support accurate fabrication and installation.
Developed façade solutions addressing weather resistance, durability, security, energy performance, and finish quality.
Supported projects for major Indonesian contractors including Adhi Karya, Wijaya Karya, Jaya Konstruksi, and PP Property.
Coordinated façade layouts with architectural intent and construction requirements across projects in multiple Indonesian cities.
